def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_row = next((i for i, r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r)) == 1 and all(r[0] not in row for row in grid[:i] + grid[i+1:])), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row+1:]
        base = max(set(x for row in a for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in a for v in row))
        return [[3 if x == y else base for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    sep_col = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and all(grid[i][j] not in row[:j] + row[j+1:] for i, row in enumerate(grid)))
    a, b = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid], [row[sep_col+1:] for row in grid]
    base = max(set(x for row in a for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in a for v in row))
    return [[3 if x == y else base for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h)))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    # Keep the left panel foreground color, marking cells where both panels share it.
    vals = [v for row in left for v in row]
    foreground = min(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    return [[3 if a == foreground and a == b else foreground
             for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)] for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]
